WITH 
-- Users with positive engagement time in 7-day period (Jan 1-7, 2021)
users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
),
-- Users with positive engagement time in 2-day period (Jan 6-7, 2021)
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM users_2day u2 WHERE u2.user_pseudo_id = u7.user_pseudo_id
)

WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*` AS t,
  UNNEST(t.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE p.v2ProductCategory = 'Home/Shop by Brand/YouTube/'
)
SELECT p.v2ProductName, SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*` AS t,
UNNEST(t.hits) AS h,
UNNEST(h.product) AS p,
youtube_buyers yb
WHERE t.fullVisitorId = yb.fullVisitorId
  AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
  AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
  AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  fullVisitorId,
  date,
  device.isMobile AS is_mobile,
  MAX(date) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId) AS max_date,
  MIN(CASE WHEN totals.transactions > 0 THEN date END) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId) AS min_txn_date
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
LIMIT 10

WITH inpatient_costs AS (
  SELECT 2011 AS year, AVG(average_medicare_payments * total_discharges) AS yearly_avg_inpatient_cost
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2011`
  WHERE provider_id = '330101'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2012, AVG(average_medicare_payments * total_discharges)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2012`
  WHERE provider_id = '330101'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2013, AVG(average_medicare_payments * total_discharges)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2013`
  WHERE provider_id = '330101'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2014, AVG(average_medicare_payments * total_discharges)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
  WHERE provider_id = '330101'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2015, AVG(average_medicare_payments * total_discharges)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2015`
  WHERE provider_id = '330101'
),
outpatient_costs AS (
  SELECT 2011 AS year, AVG(average_total_payments * outpatient_services) AS yearly_avg_outpatient_cost
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2011`
  WHERE provider_id = '330101'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2012, AVG(average_total_payments * outpatient_services)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2012`
  WHERE provider_id = '330101'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2013, AVG(average_total_payments * outpatient_services)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2013`
  WHERE provider_id = '330101'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2014, AVG(average_total_payments * outpatient_services)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2014`
  WHERE provider_id = '330101'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2015, AVG(average_total_payments * outpatient_services)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2015`
  WHERE provider_id = '330101'
)
SELECT 
  i.year,
  i.yearly_avg_inpatient_cost,
  o.yearly_avg_outpatient_cost
FROM inpatient_costs i
JOIN outpatient_costs o ON i.year = o.year
ORDER BY i.year

WITH total_persons AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`
),
persons_using_quinapril AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` de
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_strength` ds
    ON de.drug_concept_id = ds.drug_concept_id
  WHERE ds.ingredient_concept_id = 1331235
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(t.cnt - q.cnt, t.cnt) * 100 as percentage_not_using_quinapril
FROM total_persons t, persons_using_quinapril q

WITH storm_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    usa_latitude,
    usa_longitude,
    iso_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time DESC) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA' AND name = 'TEDDY'
)
SELECT usa_latitude
FROM storm_tracks
WHERE rn = 1

WITH storm_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, 
    name, 
    iso_time, 
    latitude, 
    longitude, 
    usa_wind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` 
  WHERE basin = 'NA' AND season = '2020' AND sid = '2020233N14313'
),
consecutive_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    a.sid,
    a.name,
    a.iso_time AS time1,
    a.latitude AS lat1,
    a.longitude AS lon1,
    a.usa_wind AS wind1,
    b.iso_time AS time2,
    b.latitude AS lat2,
    b.longitude AS lon2,
    b.usa_wind AS wind2,
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(a.longitude, a.latitude),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(b.longitude, b.latitude)
    ) / 1000.0 AS dist_km
  FROM storm_tracks a
  JOIN storm_tracks b ON a.sid = b.sid AND a.rn = b.rn - 1
)
SELECT 
  time1,
  lat1,
  lon1,
  wind1,
  dist_km,
  ROUND(SUM(dist_km) OVER (ORDER BY time1), 2) AS cumulative_distance_km
FROM consecutive_pairs
ORDER BY time1

WITH country_daily AS (
  SELECT s.country, gs.date, 
    AVG(gs.temp) as avg_temp,
    AVG(gs.max) as avg_max,
    AVG(gs.min) as avg_min
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` gs
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s ON gs.stn = s.usaf AND gs.wban = s.wban
  WHERE gs.mo = '10' AND gs.da BETWEEN '01' AND '31'
    AND s.country IN ('US', 'UK')
    AND gs.temp != 9999.9 AND gs.max != 9999.9 AND gs.min != 9999.9
  GROUP BY s.country, gs.date
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_temp END) as us_avg_temp,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_max END) as us_avg_max,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_min END) as us_avg_min,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN avg_temp END) as uk_avg_temp,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN avg_max END) as uk_avg_max,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN avg_min END) as uk_avg_min
  FROM country_daily
  GROUP BY date
)
SELECT 
  date,
  ROUND(us_avg_max - uk_avg_max, 1) as max_temp_diff,
  ROUND(us_avg_min - uk_avg_min, 1) as min_temp_diff,
  ROUND(us_avg_temp - uk_avg_temp, 1) as avg_temp_diff
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY date

-- Final result: all stations within 20 miles with valid temp observation counts 2011-2020
WITH stations_in_radius AS (
  SELECT 
    s.usaf,
    s.wban,
    s.name,
    s.lat,
    s.lon,
    ST_Distance(
      ST_GeogPoint(s.lon, s.lat),
      ST_GeogPoint(-73.764, 41.197)
    ) as distance_meters
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s
  WHERE ST_DWITHIN(
      ST_GeogPoint(s.lon, s.lat),
      ST_GeogPoint(-73.764, 41.197),
      32186.88
    )
    AND s.lat != 0.0
    AND s.lon != 0.0
)
SELECT 
  si.name,
  si.usaf,
  si.wban,
  ROUND(si.distance_meters / 1609.344, 2) as distance_miles,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.temp IS NOT NULL AND g.temp != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as valid_temp_observations
FROM stations_in_radius si
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` g
  ON si.usaf = g.stn AND si.wban = g.wban
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
GROUP BY si.name, si.usaf, si.wban, si.lat, si.lon, si.distance_meters
ORDER BY si.distance_meters

WITH temp_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as date,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2008' AND '2017'
    AND stn IN ('725030', '744860')
    AND temp IS NOT NULL
    AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY year, mo, da
),
complaint_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(created_date AS DATE) as date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2010 AND 2017
  GROUP BY date, complaint_type
),
complaint_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, COUNT(*) as total_complaints
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2010 AND 2017
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000
),
joined_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t.date,
    t.avg_temp,
    d.complaint_type,
    d.daily_count,
    SUM(d.daily_count) OVER (PARTITION BY t.date) as total_daily_complaints
  FROM temp_data t
  JOIN complaint_counts d ON t.date = d.date
  WHERE d.complaint_type IN (SELECT complaint_type FROM complaint_totals)
),
corr_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(avg_temp) as sum_temp,
    SUM(daily_count) as sum_count,
    SUM(avg_temp * avg_temp) as sum_temp_sq,
    SUM(daily_count * daily_count) as sum_count_sq,
    SUM(avg_temp * daily_count) as sum_temp_count,
    SUM(avg_temp * (daily_count * 1.0 / total_daily_complaints)) as sum_temp_pct,
    SUM(daily_count * 1.0 / total_daily_complaints) as sum_pct,
    SUM(POWER(daily_count * 1.0 / total_daily_complaints, 2)) as sum_pct_sq
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
corr_results AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    n as num_days,
    sum_count as total_complaints,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (n * sum_temp_count - sum_temp * sum_count),
      SQRT((n * sum_temp_sq - sum_temp * sum_temp) * (n * sum_count_sq - sum_count * sum_count))
    ), 4) as corr_temp_count,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (n * sum_temp_pct - sum_temp * sum_pct),
      SQRT((n * sum_temp_sq - sum_temp * sum_temp) * (n * sum_pct_sq - sum_pct * sum_pct))
    ), 4) as corr_temp_pct
  FROM corr_calc
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  num_days as total_days_with_valid_temp,
  total_complaints,
  corr_temp_count,
  corr_temp_pct
FROM corr_results
WHERE ABS(corr_temp_count) > 0.5
ORDER BY ABS(corr_temp_count) DESC

WITH y1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS latin_name,
    spc_common,
    COUNT(*) AS total_1995,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good','Excellent','Poor','Fair','Critical','Shaft') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_1995,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_1995
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), spc_common
),
y1995_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    latin_name,
    spc_common,
    SUM(total_1995) AS total_1995,
    SUM(alive_1995) AS alive_1995,
    SUM(dead_1995) AS dead_1995
  FROM y1995
  GROUP BY latin_name, spc_common
),
y1995_final AS (
  SELECT 
    latin_name,
    spc_common,
    total_1995,
    alive_1995,
    dead_1995
  FROM (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY latin_name ORDER BY total_1995 DESC) AS rn
    FROM y1995_agg
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
y2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS latin_name,
    spc_common,
    COUNT(*) AS total_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), spc_common
)
SELECT 
  y1.latin_name,
  y2.spc_common AS common_name,
  y1.total_1995,
  y2.total_2015,
  y1.alive_1995,
  y2.alive_2015,
  y1.dead_1995,
  y2.dead_2015,
  y2.total_2015 - y1.total_1995 AS growth_total,
  y2.alive_2015 - y1.alive_1995 AS growth_alive,
  y2.dead_2015 - y1.dead_1995 AS growth_dead
FROM y1995_final y1
INNER JOIN y2015 y2 ON y1.latin_name = y2.latin_name
ORDER BY growth_total DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    yt.pickup_location_id,
    tz.borough AS pickup_borough,
    yt.tip_amount,
    yt.fare_amount,
    yt.tolls_amount,
    yt.mta_tax,
    yt.total_amount,
    yt.passenger_count,
    yt.pickup_datetime,
    yt.dropoff_datetime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` yt
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
    ON yt.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
  WHERE yt.pickup_datetime >= '2016-01-01'
    AND yt.pickup_datetime < '2016-01-08'
    AND tz.borough NOT IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island')
    AND yt.dropoff_datetime > yt.pickup_datetime
    AND yt.passenger_count > 0
    AND yt.trip_distance >= 0
    AND yt.tip_amount >= 0
    AND yt.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND yt.mta_tax >= 0
    AND yt.fare_amount >= 0
    AND yt.total_amount >= 0
),
with_tip_rate AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    CASE 
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, fare_amount) = 0 THEN 'no tip'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, fare_amount) <= 0.05 THEN 'Less than 5%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, fare_amount) <= 0.10 THEN '5% to 10%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, fare_amount) <= 0.15 THEN '10% to 15%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, fare_amount) <= 0.20 THEN '15% to 20%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, fare_amount) <= 0.25 THEN '20% to 25%'
      ELSE 'More than 25%'
    END AS tip_category
  FROM filtered_trips
),
category_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    tip_category,
    COUNT(*) AS category_count
  FROM with_tip_rate
  GROUP BY pickup_borough, tip_category
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM with_tip_rate
  GROUP BY pickup_borough
)
SELECT 
  cc.pickup_borough,
  cc.tip_category,
  cc.category_count,
  tc.total_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(cc.category_count, tc.total_count) AS proportion
FROM category_counts cc
JOIN total_counts tc ON cc.pickup_borough = tc.pickup_borough
ORDER BY cc.pickup_borough, 
  CASE cc.tip_category
    WHEN 'no tip' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Less than 5%' THEN 2
    WHEN '5% to 10%' THEN 3
    WHEN '10% to 15%' THEN 4
    WHEN '15% to 20%' THEN 5
    WHEN '20% to 25%' THEN 6
    WHEN 'More than 25%' THEN 7
  END

SELECT 
  t.route_id,
  t.trip_headsign,
  MIN(CASE WHEN st_clay.stop_id = 14015 THEN st_clay.departure_time END) AS earliest_departure_clay,
  MAX(CASE WHEN st_sac.stop_id = 16294 THEN st_sac.arrival_time END) AS latest_arrival_sac
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.trips` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times` st_clay ON CAST(t.trip_id AS INT64) = st_clay.trip_id AND st_clay.stop_id = 14015
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times` st_sac ON CAST(t.trip_id AS INT64) = st_sac.trip_id AND st_sac.stop_id = 16294
WHERE st_clay.stop_sequence < st_sac.stop_sequence
GROUP BY t.route_id, t.trip_headsign
ORDER BY t.route_id, t.trip_headsign

SELECT 
    c.country_name,
    c.iso_3166_1_alpha_3,
    c.cumulative_confirmed,
    p.year_2018 AS population_2018,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.cumulative_confirmed, p.year_2018) * 100, 4) AS percentage_confirmed
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data` c
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country` p
    ON c.iso_3166_1_alpha_3 = p.country_code
WHERE c.date = DATE('2020-06-30')
    AND c.aggregation_level = 0
    AND c.cumulative_confirmed IS NOT NULL
    AND p.year_2018 IS NOT NULL
    AND p.year_2018 > 0
ORDER BY percentage_confirmed DESC

-- Top 5 counties in Illinois by daily new case counts frequency (exactly 5 rows)
WITH daily_county_cases AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    county,
    confirmed_cases - LAG(confirmed_cases) OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY date) AS new_cases
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_nyt.us_counties`
  WHERE state_name = 'Illinois' AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-05-31'
),
top5_counties_per_day AS (
  SELECT date, county, new_cases,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY new_cases DESC, county) as rn
  FROM daily_county_cases
  WHERE new_cases IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY new_cases DESC, county) <= 5
)
SELECT county, COUNT(*) as frequency
FROM top5_counties_per_day
GROUP BY county
ORDER BY frequency DESC, county
LIMIT 5

WITH target_zips AS (
  SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` 
  WHERE state_code = 'WA' AND ST_INTERSECTS(zip_code_geom, ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.191667, 47.685833), 5 * 1609.34))
),
tracts AS (
  SELECT ct.geo_id, ct.total_pop, ct.income_per_capita, g.tract_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr` ct
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington` g ON ct.geo_id = g.geo_id
),
intersections AS (
  SELECT 
    t.zip_code,
    tr.total_pop,
    tr.income_per_capita,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(tr.tract_geom, t.zip_code_geom)),
      ST_AREA(tr.tract_geom)
    ) as proportion
  FROM tracts tr
  JOIN target_zips t ON ST_INTERSECTS(tr.tract_geom, t.zip_code_geom)
)
SELECT 
  zip_code,
  ROUND(SUM(total_pop * proportion), 0) as total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(total_pop * proportion * income_per_capita), SUM(total_pop * proportion)), 1) as avg_individual_income
FROM intersections
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY avg_individual_income DESC

WITH top_venues AS (
  SELECT 
    'Top Venues' AS Category,
    'N/A' AS Date,
    venue_name AS Matchup_or_Venue,
    venue_capacity AS Key_Metric
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_teams`
  WHERE venue_capacity IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY venue_capacity DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
championship_margins AS (
  SELECT 
    'Biggest Championship Margins' AS Category,
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', scheduled_date) AS Date,
    CONCAT(h_name, ' vs ', a_name) AS Matchup_or_Venue,
    ABS(h_points - a_points) AS Key_Metric
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_games_sr`
  WHERE tournament_round = 'Championship' AND season > 2015
  ORDER BY Key_Metric DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
highest_scoring AS (
  SELECT 
    'Highest Scoring Games' AS Category,
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', scheduled_date) AS Date,
    CONCAT(h_name, ' vs ', a_name) AS Matchup_or_Venue,
    h_points + a_points AS Key_Metric
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_games_sr`
  WHERE season > 2010
  ORDER BY Key_Metric DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
total_threes AS (
  SELECT 
    'Total Threes' AS Category,
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', scheduled_date) AS Date,
    CONCAT(h_name, ' vs ', a_name) AS Matchup_or_Venue,
    h_three_points_made + a_three_points_made AS Key_Metric
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_games_sr`
  WHERE season > 2010
  ORDER BY Key_Metric DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT * FROM top_venues
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM championship_margins
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM highest_scoring
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM total_threes
ORDER BY 
  CASE Category 
    WHEN 'Top Venues' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'Biggest Championship Margins' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'Highest Scoring Games' THEN 3 
    WHEN 'Total Threes' THEN 4 
  END,
  Key_Metric DESC

WITH wages_1998 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries) AS avg_wage_1998
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q*`
  WHERE geoid = '42003'
),
wages_2017 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries) AS avg_wage_2017
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q*`
  WHERE geoid = '42003'
),
cpi_1998 AS (
  SELECT value AS cpi_1998
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpi_u`
  WHERE area_name = 'Pittsburgh, PA' AND item_name = 'All items' AND series_id = 'CUUSA104SA0' AND period = 'S03' AND year = 1998
),
cpi_2017 AS (
  SELECT value AS cpi_2017
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpi_u`
  WHERE area_name = 'Pittsburgh, PA' AND item_name = 'All items' AND series_id = 'CUUSA104SA0' AND period = 'S03' AND year = 2017
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(w17.avg_wage_2017 - w19.avg_wage_1998, w19.avg_wage_1998) * 100, 2) AS wage_growth_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.cpi_2017 - c.cpi_1998, c.cpi_1998) * 100, 2) AS cpi_growth_pct
FROM wages_1998 w19
CROSS JOIN wages_2017 w17
CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM cpi_1998 CROSS JOIN cpi_2017) c

WITH minute_groups AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT SAFE_CAST(trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) AS trip_minutes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds IS NOT NULL AND trip_seconds >= 60 AND trip_seconds <= 3000
),
grouped_minutes AS (
  SELECT trip_minutes, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY trip_minutes) AS quantile_group
  FROM minute_groups
),
group_ranges AS (
  SELECT quantile_group,
         MIN(trip_minutes) AS min_minutes,
         MAX(trip_minutes) AS max_minutes
  FROM grouped_minutes
  GROUP BY quantile_group
)
SELECT gr.quantile_group,
       CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(gr.min_minutes AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm to ', LPAD(CAST(gr.max_minutes AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm') AS time_range,
       COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
       ROUND(AVG(t.fare), 2) AS avg_fare
FROM group_ranges gr
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips` t
  ON SAFE_CAST(t.trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) BETWEEN gr.min_minutes AND gr.max_minutes
WHERE t.trip_seconds IS NOT NULL AND t.trip_seconds >= 60 AND t.trip_seconds <= 3000
GROUP BY gr.quantile_group, gr.min_minutes, gr.max_minutes
ORDER BY gr.quantile_group

    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(count_qualified * percent_covered / 100.0 * percent_qualified / 100.0) - SUM(existing_installs_count), 
                SUM(count_qualified * percent_covered / 100.0 * percent_qualified / 100.0)) as installation_gap_pct

census_agg AS (

    SUM(yearly_sunlight_kwh_total) as total_kwh,

    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(count_qualified * percent_covered / 100.0 * percent_qualified / 100.0) - SUM(existing_installs_count), 
                SUM(count_qualified * percent_covered / 100.0 * percent_qualified / 100.0)) as installation_gap_pct

WITH state_2015 AS (
  SELECT LEFT(CoC_Number, 2) as state_abbr, SUM(Unsheltered_Homeless) as total_unsheltered
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_hud_pit_homelessness.hud_pit_by_coc`
  WHERE Count_Year = 2015
  GROUP BY LEFT(CoC_Number, 2)
),
state_2018 AS (
  SELECT LEFT(CoC_Number, 2) as state_abbr, SUM(Unsheltered_Homeless) as total_unsheltered
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_hud_pit_homelessness.hud_pit_by_coc`
  WHERE Count_Year = 2018
  GROUP BY LEFT(CoC_Number, 2)
),
state_change AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(s15.state_abbr, s18.state_abbr) as state_abbr,
    COALESCE(s15.total_unsheltered, 0) as unsheltered_2015,
    COALESCE(s18.total_unsheltered, 0) as unsheltered_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s18.total_unsheltered, 0) - COALESCE(s15.total_unsheltered, 0), s15.total_unsheltered) * 100 as pct_change
  FROM state_2015 s15
  FULL OUTER JOIN state_2018 s18 ON s15.state_abbr = s18.state_abbr
  WHERE s15.total_unsheltered > 0
),
national_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
  FROM state_change
  WHERE state_abbr IN ('AL','AK','AZ','AR','CA','CO','CT','DE','FL','GA','HI','ID','IL','IN','IA','KS','KY','LA','ME','MD','MA','MI','MN','MS','MO','MT','NE','NV','NH','NJ','NM','NY','NC','ND','OH','OK','OR','PA','RI','SC','SD','TN','TX','UT','VT','VA','WA','WV','WI','WY')
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT sc.state_abbr, sc.pct_change, na.avg_pct_change, ABS(sc.pct_change - na.avg_pct_change) as diff_from_avg,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(sc.pct_change - na.avg_pct_change), sc.state_abbr) as rn
  FROM state_change sc, national_avg na
  WHERE sc.state_abbr IN ('AL','AK','AZ','AR','CA','CO','CT','DE','FL','GA','HI','ID','IL','IN','IA','KS','KY','LA','ME','MD','MA','MI','MN','MS','MO','MT','NE','NV','NH','NJ','NM','NY','NC','ND','OH','OK','OR','PA','RI','SC','SD','TN','TX','UT','VT','VA','WA','WV','WI','WY')
)
SELECT state_abbr
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY rn

  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON a.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE a.owner_user_id BETWEEN 16712208 AND 18712208
    AND a.creation_date >= TIMESTAMP('2019-07-01')
    AND a.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2020-01-01')

  WHERE c.user_id BETWEEN 16712208 AND 18712208

  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON a.parent_id = q.id

WITH questions_with_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    q.id AS question_id,
    q.owner_user_id,
    LENGTH(q.body) AS body_length,
    q.accepted_answer_id,
    q.view_count AS question_view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  WHERE q.id IN (
    SELECT parent_id FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
  )
),
qualifying_questions AS (
  SELECT question_id, owner_user_id, body_length, question_view_count
  FROM questions_with_answers
  WHERE accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL
  
  UNION DISTINCT
  
  SELECT DISTINCT qwa.question_id, qwa.owner_user_id, qwa.body_length, qwa.question_view_count
  FROM questions_with_answers qwa
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa ON qwa.question_id = pa.parent_id
  WHERE qwa.accepted_answer_id IS NULL
    AND SAFE_DIVIDE(pa.score, qwa.question_view_count) > 0.01
),
badge_counts AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS total_badges
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.badges`
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT 
  qq.question_id,
  qq.body_length,
  qq.owner_user_id,
  u.reputation,
  u.up_votes - u.down_votes AS net_votes,
  COALESCE(bc.total_badges, 0) AS total_badges
FROM qualifying_questions qq
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON qq.owner_user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN badge_counts bc ON qq.owner_user_id = bc.user_id
ORDER BY qq.body_length DESC
LIMIT 10

voc AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.voc_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
so2 AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.so2_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)

lead AS (

         AVG(arithmetic_mean) * 100 AS avg_lead
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.lead_daily_summary`

  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)

       ROUND(pm10.avg_pm10, 4) AS avg_pm10,
       ROUND(pm25_frm.avg_pm25_frm, 4) AS avg_pm25_frm,
       ROUND(pm25_nonfrm.avg_pm25_nonfrm, 4) AS avg_pm25_nonfrm,
       ROUND(voc.avg_voc, 4) AS avg_voc,
       ROUND(so2.avg_so2, 4) AS avg_so2,
       ROUND(lead.avg_lead, 4) AS avg_lead
FROM pm10
LEFT JOIN pm25_frm USING (month)
LEFT JOIN pm25_nonfrm USING (month)
LEFT JOIN voc USING (month)
LEFT JOIN so2 USING (month)
LEFT JOIN lead USING (month)
ORDER BY pm10.month

WITH session_start_events AS (
  SELECT
    traffic_source.medium,
    traffic_source.source,

    (SELECT MAX(CAST(e.value.int_value AS STRING)) FROM UNNEST(event_params) e WHERE e.key = 'ga_session_id') as session_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_202012*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '01' AND '31'
  AND event_name = 'session_start'
),
session_channels AS (
  SELECT
    session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(none)', '(not set)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex') AND LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) LIKE '%push' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%mobile%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%notification%' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp') 
        OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch') 
        OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%video%' THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex') 
        AND (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp') 
        AND (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch') 
        AND (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END as channel
  FROM session_start_events
)
SELECT
  channel,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) as session_count,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) DESC) as rank
FROM session_channels
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY rank

-- Full cohort analysis with Week 2 retention
WITH user_first_session AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_date) AS first_session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20180930'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
user_cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_date), INTERVAL MOD(EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_date)) + 5, 7) DAY) AS cohort_week
  FROM user_first_session
  WHERE first_session_date BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20180921'
),
cohort_weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cohort_week
  FROM user_cohort
),
cohort_with_target AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_week,
    DATE_ADD(cohort_week, INTERVAL 14 DAY) AS target_date
  FROM cohort_weeks
),
-- Get distinct user-session_date pairs for target dates
target_activity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    ct.target_date,
    e.user_pseudo_id
  FROM cohort_with_target ct
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON e.event_date = FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', ct.target_date)
    AND e.event_name = 'session_start'
),
-- Count retained users per cohort
retention_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    target_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) AS retained_count
  FROM target_activity
  GROUP BY target_date
)
SELECT 
  cw.cohort_week,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_cohort uc WHERE uc.cohort_week = cw.cohort_week) AS cohort_size,
  COALESCE(rc.retained_count, 0) AS retained_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(rc.retained_count, 0), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_cohort uc WHERE uc.cohort_week = cw.cohort_week)) AS retention_rate
FROM cohort_weeks cw
LEFT JOIN retention_counts rc ON cw.cohort_week = rc.target_date
ORDER BY cw.cohort_week

WITH first_open_events AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) as first_open_shanghai
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'first_open'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180930'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE(first_open_shanghai) as first_open_date
  FROM first_open_events
  WHERE DATE(first_open_shanghai) BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2018-09-07'
),
user_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) as event_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20181010'
),
retention_flags AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    c.first_open_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ue.event_date IS NOT NULL 
             AND DATE_DIFF(ue.event_date, c.first_open_date, DAY) BETWEEN 1 AND 7 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week1_retained,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ue.event_date IS NOT NULL 
             AND DATE_DIFF(ue.event_date, c.first_open_date, DAY) BETWEEN 8 AND 14 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week2_retained,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ue.event_date IS NOT NULL 
             AND DATE_DIFF(ue.event_date, c.first_open_date, DAY) BETWEEN 15 AND 21 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week3_retained
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN user_events ue ON c.user_pseudo_id = ue.user_pseudo_id
  GROUP BY c.user_pseudo_id, c.first_open_date
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(week1_retained), COUNT(*)) as week_1_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(week2_retained), COUNT(*)) as week_2_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(week3_retained), COUNT(*)) as week_3_retention_rate
FROM retention_flags
